resources.string: 139 Yun: China Mobile\'s 139 personal cloud drive (yun.139.com). Supports several accounts, each under its own alias \u2014 switch between them via Favourites, same as ftp/sftp/smb/webdav.
e.g. work, personal \u2014 a local label, not your phone number

Paste the \"Authorization\" request header value that yun.139.com sends when you are logged in on the web (without the leading \"Basic \"). Only token-based login is supported; username/password login is not implemented. To use more than one 139 Yun account, add each one here under its own alias, then bookmark each account\'s folder separately via Favourites to switch between them.
Please enter an account alias first.
This account needs a token \u2014 paste it below and tap OK.
